Package com.example

Class FilledBoard

java.lang.Object
com.example.Board
com.example.FilledBoard
public class FilledBoard extends Board
The FilledBoard class represents a game board pre-filled with pawns based on the number of players. Pawns are placed on squares of specific colors corresponding to each player.
